declaration_context: Before any complete main-screen workload or model outcome was available. Parent reported 22 incomplete screen records. Only separate protocol/control validation had been inspected.
secondary_target: absolute log(t_candidate_ms), sensitivity analysis only; do not select target based on results
default_timing_usage: Construct training/evaluation labels only; no default or candidate timing is an inference feature
feature_sets: workload + raw requested knobs + planner descriptors
primary_grouping: GroupKFold by exact N, all batch regimes and candidate configurations together, up to 5 folds
secondary_grouping: GroupKFold by odd part of N, leaving entire pow2/mixed3/mixed5 families out, up to 5 folds (3 for main design)
training_weights: Equal workload weight: candidate weight 1/19 for each complete workload. All methods use identical complete-workload support and splits.
preprocessing: Fit DictVectorizer vocabulary on training rows only; test-only fields are ignored
baselines: single globally fixed configuration selected by training-workload geometric mean only
tie_policy: Canonical row order by workload, default first, then candidate ID; stable minimum predicted cost wins ties
metrics: geometric mean slowdown versus tested oracle
interpretation: Exploratory screen-based model selection quality, not independent confirmation. All plans were actually initialized. No measured plan-only path, compile avoidance, or online end-to-end model overhead.
